about_the_game:
Overage – Child of Chaos is a fast-paced roguelike and horde-style shooter

developed by CopyCat Game Studios. It is a game that delivers an intense and rewarding power trip, where players confront challenging enemies while embracing the chaos. The game cleverly satirizes familiar media tropes, letting players battle through exaggerated clichés with a mix of skill and strategy. Although the combat requires precision and quick thinking, each victory makes players feel like an unstoppable force, with the thrill of overcoming tough obstacles. The chaotic energy, combined with witty humor, creates an epic,

adrenaline-pumping experience that’s both challenging and empowering.

content_descriptors.notes:
Overage contains violence that involves shooting and killing demons. Demons will bleed when shot, and some with explode (however, this is done though 2D sprites). There is also blood and gore when the player dies.

There is an instance where the main character purposfully cooks a grenede and blows himself up (he comes back to life immediatly after, but he did it with the intent of self harm.)

The game also contains strong language and drug reference.
